typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FilePathFurureBreaks as string ('\\ cwcnhf501.wellsfargo.com\\DRSDev\\WFSOpsKRIReporting\\DropZone\\GMI\\StreetsideActivity\\FuturesBreaks\\\\StreetActivity_20250128.csv'),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		SecurityID as string,
		Status as string,
		{Risk Date} as string,
		{Aged Days} as string,
		Inventory as string,
		BOOK as string,
		GMISubProdSymbol as string,
		GMISymExch as string,
		ImagineSymExch as string,
		SecurityDescription as string,
		Put_Call_Strike as string,
		LTD as string,
		GMIContractQty as string,
		ImagineContractQty as string,
		CurrentPosDIFF as string,
		EffectiveDate as string,
		Comment as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		FileName = toString((substring(toString($FilePathFurureBreaks), toInteger(102), toInteger(27)))),
		FileDate = toString((substring(toString($FilePathFurureBreaks), toInteger(117), toInteger(8))))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Status as string,
		Comment as string,
		ImagineContractQty as integer,
		FileName as string,
		Load_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		GMISubProdSymbol as string,
		GMIContractQty as integer,
		RiskDate as string,
		ImagineSymExch as string,
		Put_Call_Strike as string,
		SecurityDescription as string,
		AgedDays as string,
		BOOK as string,
		GMISymExch as string,
		SecurityID as string,
		CurrentPosDIFF as integer,
		LTD as string,
		Inventory as string,
		EffectiveDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		Comment,
		ImagineContractQty,
		FileName,
		Load_Date = LoadDate,
		GMISubProdSymbol,
		GMIContractQty,
		RiskDate = {Risk Date},
		ImagineSymExch,
		Put_Call_Strike,
		SecurityDescription,
		AgedDays = {Aged Days},
		BOOK,
		GMISymExch,
		SecurityID,
		CurrentPosDIFF,
		LTD,
		Inventory,
		EffectiveDate),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
